Package com.listochef.service

Class UserService

java.lang.Object
com.listochef.service.UserService
@Service public class UserService extends Object
Service responsible for managing user-related operations. This class handles: - User registration and profile management - Authentication-related updates (password reset/change) - Grocery and pantry list management - Recipe saved toggling - Ticket creation and deletion - User deletion and cleanup operations

    • register

      public void register(User user)
      Registers a new user in the system. This method: - Validates required fields - Normalizes email - Hashes the password - Assigns a random avatar - Initializes empty lists (grocery and pantry)
      Parameters:
      user - User object to register.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if required fields are missing.
      RuntimeException - if user already exists.
